<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 640 360" font-family="'Arial Black','Segoe UI',Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif">
  <!-- Acid Cola: the can drops in, fizz rises, the name slams in, the tagline sours. -->
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="ac_bg" cx="0.5" cy="0.55" r="0.75"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#1c3a08"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#030602"/></radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="ac_can" x1="0" x2="1"><stop offset="0" stop-color="#3c6e10"/><stop offset="0.35" stop-color="#b8ff3a"/><stop offset="0.55" stop-color="#e8ffb0"/><stop offset="1" stop-color="#2a5008"/></linearGradient>
    <filter id="ac_glow" x="-30%" y="-30%" width="160%" height="160%"><feGaussianBlur stdDeviation="4" result="b"/><feMerge><feMergeNode in="b"/><feMergeNode in="SourceGraphic"/></feMerge></filter>
  </defs>
  <rect width="640" height="360" fill="url(#ac_bg)"/>
  <g stroke="#a0ff20" stroke-opacity="0.12" stroke-width="2">
    <path d="M320 200 L0 0 M320 200 L160 0 M320 200 L480 0 M320 200 L640 0 M320 200 L640 200 M320 200 L0 200 M320 200 L0 360 M320 200 L640 360 M320 200 L320 360 M320 200 L320 0">
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" from="0 320 200" to="360 320 200" dur="24s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </path>
  </g>
  <g fill="#c8ff70" opacity="0.7">
    <circle cx="300" cy="250" r="3"><animate attributeName="cy" values="250;30" dur="1.6s" begin="0.9s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="335" cy="250" r="2"><animate attributeName="cy" values="250;30" dur="1.2s" begin="1.1s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="318" cy="250" r="4"><animate attributeName="cy" values="250;30" dur="2s" begin="1.3s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="290" cy="250" r="2"><animate attributeName="cy" values="250;30" dur="1.4s" begin="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
    <circle cx="346" cy="250" r="3"><animate attributeName="cy" values="250;30" dur="1.8s" begin="1.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/></circle>
  </g>
  <g transform="translate(0,-300)">
    <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0,-300;0,12;0,-6;0,0" keyTimes="0;0.6;0.8;1" dur="0.9s" fill="freeze"/>
    <rect x="285" y="120" width="70" height="120" rx="10" fill="url(#ac_can)" stroke="#e8ffb0" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="320" cy="122" rx="35" ry="6" fill="#d0d8c0"/>
    <text x="320" y="188" font-size="22" fill="#0a1404" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90 320 180)">ACID</text>
  </g>
  <g filter="url(#ac_glow)" opacity="0">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.05s" begin="1.2s" fill="freeze"/>
    <g transform="translate(320 70)">
      <g><animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="scale" values="3;0.95;1" keyTimes="0;0.7;1" dur="0.35s" begin="1.2s" fill="freeze"/>
        <text x="0" y="22" font-size="64" fill="#a0ff20" text-anchor="middle" letter-spacing="6">ACID COLA</text>
      </g>
    </g>
  </g>
  <text x="320" y="300" font-size="26" fill="#e8ffb0" text-anchor="middle" font-style="italic" opacity="0">"Reality Hurts."<animate attributeName="opacity" values="0;1" dur="0.6s" begin="2.2s" fill="freeze"/><animate attributeName="fill" values="#e8ffb0;#ff4060;#e8ffb0" dur="0.25s" begin="3.4s" repeatCount="3"/></text>
  <text x="620" y="345" font-size="9" fill="#5a8030" text-anchor="end" font-family="monospace">ACID COLA IS A BEVERAGE. NOT ALL REALITIES ARE COVERED.</text>
</svg>
name: acid_cola_logo
